7.1.q: Which UML diagram is described as the most commonly used in practice?
7.1.vi: Class diagram là sơ đồ dùng nhiều nhất trong thực tế.
7.1.en: The class diagram is the most commonly used diagram in practice.

7.1.q: What are the three compartments of a UML class box?
7.1.en: A class shows its name, attributes and operations.

7.1.q: In the attribute "-baseSalary: float", what does the colon introduce?
7.1.vi: Kiểu dữ liệu được viết sau dấu hai chấm.
7.1.en: The data type is specified after a colon.

7.1.q: In UML, the symbol # in front of an attribute means:
Which is a valid notation for an interface?
o: A dashed rectangle with no name
7.1.vi: Interface: một hình tròn kèm tên, hoặc một class có stereotype <<interface>>.
7.1.en: An interface is a named circle or a class with the <<interface>> stereotype.

7.2.q: Two classes have a dependency relationship when:
o: One class is used as a parameter in an operation of the other
One class owns the lifetime of the other
One class is a subclass of the other
Both classes are stored in the same table
7.2.vi: Dependency: một operation gọi operation của class khác, hoặc class kia là tham số. Lỏng nhất trong các quan hệ.
7.2.en: Dependency: one operation calls another class's operation, or one class is a parameter. It is the least restrictive.

o: A general class and a more specific class
A class and its database table
An actor and a use case
7.2.en: Generalization relates a superclass and a subclass.

7.2.q: In "Person — works for — Company", what are +employee and +employer?
o: Role names at the two ends of the association
7.2.vi: Association có thể có tên (works for) và role ở hai đầu (+employee, +employer). Multiplicity là 1..* và 0..*.
7.2.en: An association can have a name (works for) and roles at both ends (+employee, +employer); the multiplicities are 1..* and 0..*.

7.2.q: A University owns its Faculties and is responsible for their lifetime. This is:
7.2.vi: Composition: association mạnh, sở hữu và chịu trách nhiệm vòng đời (thoi đặc).
7.2.en: Composition: a strong association that owns the lifetime (filled diamond).

o: A weak association: a class uses another but does not own it
A strong association that controls the other's lifetime
7.2.vi: Aggregation: association yếu, dùng nhưng không sở hữu (thoi rỗng).
7.2.en: Aggregation: a weak association, using without owning (hollow diamond).

7.2.q: In the Online Shop example, how are Credit, Cash and Check related to Payment?
o: They are subclasses of the abstract class Payment
They depend on Order through Payment
7.2.vi: Payment là abstract class; Credit, Cash, Check là subclass qua generalization.
7.2.en: Payment is abstract; Credit, Cash and Check are its subclasses.

o: A real-world entity that takes a role in the business process and has stored data
An entity created only to support processing and calculations
A screen or form shown to the user
A temporary variable inside an operation
7.3.vi: Domain object: thực thể ngoài đời, có vai trò trong nghiệp vụ, có dữ liệu lưu. System object: tạo ra để xử lý.
7.3.en: Domain objects are real-world entities with stored data; system objects support processing.

7.3.q: In BCE, which object coordinates the steps of one use case?
7.3.vi: Control điều phối các bước của một use case, ví dụ RegistrationController.
7.3.en: The control object coordinates one use case, e.g. RegistrationController.

7.3.q: Which BCE rule of thumb is correct?
o: Entities call boundaries to show results
7.3.vi: Actor chỉ nói chuyện với boundary; entity không bao giờ gọi boundary; boundary và control là system object.
7.3.en: Actors talk only to boundaries; entities never call boundaries; boundary and control are system objects.

7.3.q: In step 1, candidate domain classes come from:
o: Nouns in use case specifications and user stories
Column names of an existing spreadsheet only
7.3.vi: Ứng viên class là các danh từ trong use case spec và user story.
7.3.en: Candidate classes are the nouns in use case specs and user stories.

7.4.q: In step 2, when do you create boundary and control objects?
o: When no domain object can perform a step of the use case
Only after the database is designed
For every noun in the requirements
7.4.vi: Mỗi bước trong kịch bản phải do một object làm; nếu không domain object nào làm được thì tạo boundary/control.
7.4.en: Every step must be performed by some object; create boundary and control objects when no domain object can do it.

7.4.q: In a sequence diagram, which combined fragment expresses if/else?
7.4.vi: alt = if/else, opt = if, loop = lặp, par = song song.
7.4.en: alt = if/else, opt = if, loop, par = parallel.

7.4.q: Every message in a sequence diagram should become:
o: An operation in the class diagram
A new table in the database
7.4.vi: Mỗi message trở thành một operation trong class diagram.
7.4.en: Every message should become an operation in the class diagram.

7.4.q: In the Login failed scenario, Encryptor and LoginAccount are classified as:
7.4.vi: Encryptor (bước 4) và LoginAccount (bước 5) là system object.
7.4.en: Encryptor (step 4) and LoginAccount (step 5) are system objects.

7.4.q: "Same operation, different data or processing" calls for:
7.4.vi: Dữ liệu dùng chung → inheritance; cùng operation, xử lý khác → polymorphism; giấu dữ liệu → encapsulation.
7.4.en: Shared data → inheritance; same operation, different processing → polymorphism; hide data → encapsulation.

7.4.q: In a state machine, how is a transition written?
7.4.vi: Transition viết dạng event [guard] / action, ví dụ cancel [before shipping] / refund.
7.4.en: Transitions read event [guard] / action, e.g. cancel [before shipping] / refund.

o: Depending on interfaces and passing data explicitly
Putting every responsibility in one module
7.5.vi: Low coupling: phụ thuộc vào interface, truyền dữ liệu tường minh, tránh trạng thái toàn cục.
7.5.en: Low coupling: depend on interfaces, pass data explicitly, avoid shared global state.

o: One module has one clear responsibility
Modules depend strongly on each other
7.5.vi: Cohesion cao: một module = một trách nhiệm rõ ràng.
7.5.en: High cohesion: one module = one clear responsibility.

7.5.q: A "God class" that does everything violates which SOLID principle?
7.5.vi: S: một class chỉ có một lý do để thay đổi; vi phạm thì sinh ra God class.
7.5.en: S: a class has one reason to change; violating it gives a God class.

7.5.q: Business logic that creates database objects directly violates:
7.5.vi: D: phụ thuộc vào abstraction, không vào class cụ thể.
7.5.en: D: depend on abstractions, not concrete classes.

7.5.vi: YAGNI = You Aren't Gonna Need It. DRY = Don't Repeat Yourself, KISS = Keep It Simple.
7.5.en: YAGNI = You Aren't Gonna Need It; DRY = Don't Repeat Yourself; KISS = Keep It Simple.

7.6.q: Which question do creational patterns answer?
o: How are classes and objects composed?
How do objects interact and share responsibilities?
How is data stored in tables?
7.6.vi: Creational: tạo object. Structural: ghép class/object. Behavioral: tương tác, chia trách nhiệm.
7.6.en: Creational: creation. Structural: composition. Behavioral: interaction and responsibilities.

7.6.q: Adapter, Facade and Proxy belong to which group?
7.6.vi: Structural: Adapter, Bridge, Composite, Decorator, Facade, Flyweight, Proxy.
7.6.en: Structural: Adapter, Bridge, Composite, Decorator, Facade, Flyweight, Proxy.

7.6.q: Email, SMS and the app must be notified when a booking changes. Which pattern fits?
7.6.vi: Báo nhiều bên khi một thứ thay đổi → Observer.
7.6.en: Notifying many parties when something changes → Observer.

7.6.q: Why should Singleton be used carefully?
7.6.vi: Singleton cho một object cấu hình dùng chung, nhưng làm khó test.
7.6.en: Singleton gives one shared configuration object but hurts testability.

7.6.q: In the Strategy example, what is the benefit of adding a new pricing rule?
o: A new class is added and Booking is not changed
Booking gets a longer if/else chain
All pricing classes must be rewritten
7.6.vi: Luật mới = class mới, không sửa Booking (Open/Closed), mỗi luật unit test riêng được.
7.6.en: A new rule is a new class; Booking stays unchanged (Open/Closed), and each rule is testable alone.

7.7.q: Which is a disadvantage of storing data in a file system?
o: It is hard to manage large data
It is complex to set up and administer
It is slow for small data
7.7.vi: File system: đơn giản, nhanh, nhưng khó quản lý dữ liệu lớn. Database: phức tạp hơn để cài đặt.
7.7.en: Files are simple and fast but hard to manage at scale; databases are more complex to set up.

7.7.q: When mapping classes to tables, object identity becomes:
7.7.vi: Entity class → bảng, attribute → cột, object identity → primary key.
7.7.en: Entity class → table, attributes → columns, identity → primary key.

7.7.q: How is a 1 – n association mapped to relational tables?
o: A foreign key on the "many" side
A foreign key on the "one" side
A junction table with two foreign keys
One shared table for both classes
7.7.vi: 1–n: FK ở phía n (student.class_id). n–n: junction table.
7.7.en: 1–n: FK on the many side (student.class_id). n–n: a junction table.

7.7.q: Which mapping is used for composition?
o: FK NOT NULL + ON DELETE CASCADE
A junction table with extra columns
7.7.vi: Composition: FK NOT NULL và ON DELETE CASCADE, vì phần tử con sống theo phần tử cha.
7.7.en: Composition: FK NOT NULL with ON DELETE CASCADE, since the part lives with the whole.

7.7.q: According to the checklist, when should you denormalize?
o: Whenever a table has more than five columns
7.7.vi: Chuẩn hoá tới 3NF; chỉ denormalize khi đã chứng minh cần cho hiệu năng.
7.7.en: Normalize to 3NF; denormalize only for proven performance needs.

o: As plain text in a UNIQUE column
7.7.vi: Lưu mật khẩu dạng hash, thu thập ít và bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.
7.7.en: Store passwords as hashes and protect personal data.
